title: compiler.validateSource
description: validateSource in validate.go refuses a slot binding with no operator or with more than one of gate, chain and fan-out.

title: types.Stage
description: Not written yet: no component.yaml declares a stage today. This names where the stage type and its check will live.

title: registry.Trust
description: Not written yet: today the order of the sources stands for trust, and the first source is the common registry. This names where an explicit trust will live.

title: compiler.validDigest
description: validDigest accepts exactly 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits. validateStatePaths applies the same rule to the registry content digest.

title: buildidentity.Record
description: Record holds the build identity, and Record.Validate refuses an unsafe value, an unknown source state and an incomplete source record.

title: install
description: install refuses a revision that is not 40 lower-case hexadecimal digits before any other step.

title: types.SlotRef
description: Not written yet: implements is a plain string, and runRegistryFills splits it at the period without checking its form.

title: appbuild.Inventory
description: Inventory holds the SDK's file count, bytes and digest. The release it must match is the compiler's GoVersion today, not an archetype's pin.
